content: Muḥammad Ṭūsī, in a treatise written for Bāysunghur, refers to a majlis-i tafaḥḥuṣ u dīvān-i tajassus responsible for interrogating Hurufis brought to trial (R. Majmaʿ al-Tahānī, 30); Melvin-Koushki says this was presumably the same body that conducted Ibn Turka's three trials.
refers_to_primary: Muḥammad Ṭūsī, R. Majmaʿ al-Tahānī u Maḥżar al-Amānī, 30
